entities.name: Kuro
entities.description: Oni pitlord of Kamigawa active during the Kami War, who bargains eternal life for eternal service.

entities.name: Ink-Eyes
entities.description: Nezumi taken by Kuro as a minion.

entities.name: Muzan
entities.description: Ogre taken by Kuro as a minion.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Kuro was active.

events.summary: Kuro offers bargains of eternal life for eternal service and takes many as minions, including Ink-Eyes and Muzan.
events.quote: In this manner, Kuro took many as his minions, including the nezumi Ink-Eyes and the ogre Muzan .
